newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian rupee ends at 35.84/85 vs dlr in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Indian rupee ends at 35.84/85 vs dlr in dull trade.

text.p: The Indian rupee closed at 35.84/85 against the dollar in dull trade on Monday.
The rupee opened the day at 35.85/86 a dollar and most of the day's deals were in the 35.852/35.850 band, dealers said.
Good dollar supply and lack of active buying by a state-run bank, a trend seen the beginning of January, continued.
The Reserve Bank of India stepped in toward the close of trading on Monday to buy dollars at 35.85 level, dealers said.
The forward dollar market did not see major fluctuations. The six-month annualised forward premium closed at 7.23 percent compared with Friday's close of 7.31 percent, dealers said.
